summary: On Fri, Jul 3, 2026 at 10:10 PM Steven Leonowicz dba DVSC wrote: > Subject: > Golf Advisory Committee Meeting Summary > Meeting Date: June 3
_full_body: On Fri, Jul 3, 2026 at 10:10 PM Steven Leonowicz dba DVSC wrote: > Subject: > Golf Advisory Committee Meeting Summary > Meeting Date: June 30, 2026 > Submitted by: Carolyn Story > > Summary: > > > GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE > June 9, 2026 > Carolyn M. Story - Liaison > Manager's Report - Megan stated that the monthly income for the end of the season was > $1,257. The new color for the 2025-2026 golf membership sticker is purple. > Caroline Zimmerman reported that the purpose of this meeting was to develop a Code of > Conduct. The USGA standards of player conduct were referenced. > Motion was made to develop a Code of Conduct. > Discussion regarding penalties ensued. Add penalties to the Code of Conduct to address > violators, play with no pay, repeat violators, and residents' responsibility for non-paying > guests. > Motion was made to develop violations and penalties. > To address issues initially and for further problems to be escalated through a process > starting with the Golf Advisory Committee, Rules & Regulations, and Resource > Management. > Motion was made that Players must sign in the book EVERY time a round is played. > Article in the July LINK "A Healthier You - Through Golf at Palm Hill". Anyone interested in > writing a golf related article for the LIN please contact Caroline Zimmerman. > Megan stated that residents should reach out to their insurance regarding reimbursement > to use the medical/wellness card to pay for their golf membership fee. > Next meeting September 8, 2026. > That concludes my concise report for this month. > Golf Advisory Committee > May 12, 2026 Carolyn M. Story, Liaison Report > Superintendent Report - Putting green and Sod green in process > Update on Pro Shop landscaping: shrubs removed on west side, soil prepped & leveled for replanting in > 2-3 wks.; front of Pro Shop shrubs removed and will be replaced with low growing, low maintenance > shrubs. Pictures of landscaping projects were presented to the committee. Joe Clay and staff were > supported with volunteers - Randy Mitchell, Howard Sneed and Mike McCarthy. > Growing season / mowing season underway, irrigation system supplying water, rainfall needed, currently > 14" below normal. > Managers' Report - April Monthly Financial Report - 175 Members, 84 golf carts, 89 10 pks sold to > date; Under budget $12,000 YTD > New memberships start July 1st; purchases will be available in June. > Pro Shop is closed for the season; staff will continue to pick up cash box money and bring to Admin > Office. > Pro Shop is closed for the season; staff will continue to pick up cash box money and bring to Admin > Office. > Janitorial service - Ongoing regular cleaning > Play without Pay issues discussed; Invoices will be sent to violators > Board Liaison- Carolyn Story reported the following: > New sign on netting between 3rd and 4th holes. > Netting on the 7th hole has been repaired by maintenance. > Women's Association - Sue Waldecker reported Letter painting on yardage markers completed by > Ladies Association volunteers: Terri McGilvray, Sue Waldecker, Mary Tillman and Kathy Kummer > Plaque for 90-year-old Honoraries is in progress; completion and pick up will be in September. > Men's Association - no report. Lawrence Lotze absent > C Zimmerman thanked the Men's & Ladies Association for the joint work on many projects and events. > Couples - Mike Mc Carthy reported a great year, season ended with Men's & Women's Hot Dog > Scramble. Special Thanks to Jim Jones (& Sandy) for dedicated work for Couples Golf. > Future Planning - no report - Mike Leahy absent > Bandits - Randy Mitchell reported that Bandits continue for 6 days per week. Successful events this > year. > Community Engagement Initiatives > 2026 - 2027 Event Flyer shared in packet > Discussed Golf Clinic scheduled for November 18, 2026; open to residents of PHCC community; free > day of golf leaming; expect teaching stations for Etiquette / Rules, Putting, Chipping, Driving, Sand trap > along with playing alongside current members. The committee agreed to have classes "Co-Ed". B. > Newport suggested contacting N & S Clubhouses to contribute to the event. Sign Up sheets will be > > > > 2026 - 2027 Event Flyer shared in packet > Discussed Golf Clinic scheduled for November 18, 2026; open to residents of PHCC community; free > day of golf leaming; expect teaching stations for Etiquette / Rules, Putting, Chipping, Driving, Sand trap > along with playing alongside current members. The committee agreed to have classes "Co-Ed". B. > Newport suggested contacting N & S Clubhouses to contribute to the event. Sign Up sheets will be > completed to know the number of participants for event day. Additionally, a January Golf Clinic may be > added. > Purpose: Encourage community members to come out and try golf. > Will organize a "19th Hole" to celebrate the end of the Golf Clinic Day; Sue Waldecker, Carolyn Story > and Golf Committee members volunteered to organize and help coordinate events. > Carolyn Story suggested marketing C Zimmerman's weekly Free Golf Lessons > Golf Fees - Sue Waldecker that the group will reconvene in Fall to review different types of membership > and process for how annual memberships are adjusted. > Caroline Zimmerman provided a brief report; PHCC cannot be compared to Largo Golf Course or > Fairway Village. C Zimmerman continues to analyze the sign-up sheets and recommended redesigning, > moving the times and complete player names.
